text: しかし　＊は　わざを　４つ　おぼえるので　せいいっぱいだ！

structure.jp: わざを　４つ　おぼえるので

patterns.name: 〜のでせいいっぱいだ
patterns.span: おぼえるので　せいいっぱいだ
patterns.explanation: Here ので is not 'because': の turns 'learning' into a thing and で means 'with'. Together with せいいっぱいだ it says that doing that much is all one can manage. おぼえるので せいいっぱいだ = 'learning them is all it can manage'.
